name: linux-to-me-recipient-filter
description: `poll --to-me` is the recipient filter (LBA-REQ-013): from the LINUX plane it keeps a message addressed `to: LINUX` and a broadcast (no `to`), and DROPS one addressed `to: WIN`. The mock fixture-priority discussion has three WIN messages — P0 to LINUX (urgent-p0-to-linux), P1 to WIN (high-p1-to-win), P3 broadcast (routine-p3-broadcast). With --to-me the LINUX reader must see the LINUX-addressed and the broadcast but NOT the WIN-addressed one. Proves addressing is enforced, not cosmetic.
